title: Kosmosdan qaytgan astronavt yurishni qayta o'rganadi

scenes.text: Ichki quloqdagi muvozanat a'zosi vaznsizlikka moslashib qoladi.
Yerga tushgach, miya og'irlikka qayta o'rganadi: bu kunlar, ba'zan haftalar oladi.
Shuning uchun qaytgan astronavtlar dastlab gandiraklab yuradi.
scenes.keywords: person walking unsteady close up feet

description: Vaznsizlikda ichki quloqdagi muvozanat a'zosi va miya yangi sharoitga moslashadi, shuning uchun astronavtlar Yerga qaytgach bir necha kun yoki hafta davomida yurish va muvozanatni qayta tiklaydi.
source: https://www.frontiersin.org/journals/physiology/articles/10.3389/fphys.2025.1677377/full (Frontiers in Physiology 2025: postflight vestibular and sensorimotor impairment after short and long missions); https://ntrs.nasa.gov/api/citations/20130000770/downloads/20130000770.pdf (NASA NTRS: postflight balance/vestibular readaptation); https://sciworthy.com/how-can-astronauts-regain-balance-after-spaceflight/ (explainer: recovery takes days to about two weeks).
